rows.definition: n_ctx is the per-slot context window a llama-server-class upstream reports: /props default_generation_settings.n_ctx, each /slots entry's n_ctx, and the n_ctx field of its exceed_context_size_error 400 body. It is the largest prompt plus output one request can use on that upstream.
rows.distinction: n_ctx is the UPSTREAM's per-request (per-slot) window, already divided across --parallel slots - NOT the whole --ctx-size, and NOT fak's own context window (the in-kernel model's budget). The proxy gateway reads it to advertise context_window on /v1/models and to type a context_length_exceeded error; it never sizes fak's own planning budget.
